answer: Make every new identity climb a terrace of trust: fresh accounts start on the bottom step, and only graders outside their invite tree can promote them by scoring real work over several epochs. From afar a sybil farm looks like a nebula of independent agents, but up close its accounts share one inviter, one timing rhythm and one voice, so non-kin graders won't vouch. Standing decays unless renewed, so an idle clone becomes a relic with no vote, not a sleeper ballot.
